map.支持成本加成、目标利润、竞品参照、价值定价四种策略，输出建议售价、毛利率与盈亏平: Supports four strategies - cost-plus, target profit, competitor reference and value pricing - and outputs the suggested price, gross margin and break-even volume.
map.成本加成定价：在成本上叠加目标加成率，快速得到建议售价与毛利率。: Cost-plus pricing: add a target markup to the cost to quickly get a suggested price and gross margin.
map.目标利润定价：已知固定成本与目标总利润、预计销量，倒推必须达到的单价。: Target profit pricing: given fixed costs, a target total profit and expected volume, back out the unit price that must be achieved.
map.竞品/价值定价：以竞品价或客户感知价值乘偏差/捕获率，做差异化定价。: Competitor and value-based pricing: take the competitor's price or the perceived value times a deviation or capture rate, for differentiated pricing.
map.举例：成本 80 元、加成 25%、月固定成本 2000 元: Example: cost 80 CNY, markup 25%, monthly fixed cost 2000 CNY
map.：售价 = 80 × (1 + 25%) = 100 元；单位毛利 = 100:
Price = 80 x (1 + 25%) = 100 CNY; unit gross profit = 100 - 80 = 20 CNY; gross margin = 20/100 = 20.0%.
Break-even volume = fixed cost / unit gross profit = 2000 / 20 = 100 units (100 units covers the fixed cost).
With the "target profit" mode instead, a target profit of 2000 and volume of 100 give price = 80 + (2000+2000)/100 = 120 CNY.
map.四种定价策略分别怎么用？: How Is Each of the Four Pricing Strategies Used?
map.成本加成最稳妥；目标利润保证回本；竞品参照适合红海；价值定价适合差异化/高感知价: Cost-plus is the safest; target profit guarantees payback; competitor reference suits crowded markets; value pricing suits differentiated products or high perceived value. You can compare suggested prices and margins side by side.
map.盈亏平衡销量怎么来的？: Where Does Break-Even Volume Come From?
map.盈亏平衡销量 = 月固定成本 ÷ 单位毛利。上例单位毛利 20 元、固定 200: Break-even volume = monthly fixed cost / unit gross profit. With a unit gross profit of 20 CNY and fixed cost of 2000 CNY, 100 units covers the fixed cost; only the volume beyond that contributes net profit.
